motivation: Test whether the unchanged BP-first geometry-routed LP96 cascade generalizes beyond the fixed opposite-corner endpoint convention. Endpoint placement changes while the connected180x180 loop80 wall generator, three immutable decoder/hidden checkpoints, inference caps and routing predicate stay fixed. A valid simple path can be longer than shortest; this distribution shift may expose those BP false accepts.

cohort.seed_rule: Reserve one exact unused base only after independent design review and a complete prior-seed registry audit. Never search seeds by outcomes.
cohort.maze_rng: Generate the original connected maze using S.maze(180,0.8,SeedSequence([BASE,180,80,input_index])). Preserve its randomized DFS, exact80percent opening of closed connectors, rotation and reflection. Discard only its original-corner shortest label; retain original generator counts and endpoint coordinates as provenance.
cohort.restore_original_endpoints: Copy the token grid and set BOTH original endpoint tokens2 and3 to ordinary open token1 before selecting new endpoints. Keep every wall0 and ordinary open cell1 unchanged. Original corner endpoint cells remain eligible for either new endpoint with exactly the same probability as every other open cell.
cohort.endpoint_rng: Use a separate independently derived endpoint stream, default_rng(SeedSequence([BASE,180,80,input_index,1])). Enumerate all open flat indices in ascending row-major order and call rng.choice(open_indices,size=2,replace=False). Assign the first draw token2 (start), the second token3 (goal).
cohort.uniform_pair_law: Conditional on the generated wall grid withN open cells, each ordered pair(s,t) with s!=t has probability1/[N(N-1)]. Start and goal are ordered because the model distinguishes tokens2 and3. The only endpoint-selection exclusion is equality: zero-distance pairs are disallowed. Adjacent endpoints, original corners, leaves, junctions and all other open cells remain eligible. No rejection/resampling by Euclidean/Manhattan/shortest distance, node degree, graph difficulty, decoder output, numerical flags or success.
cohort.labels: After assigning the endpoints, recompute the full shortest-path label and edge distance with the production generator BFS. Independently validate all4096 labels/distances with the separate graph auditor before model inference. Every original maze is connected and the endpoint rewrite preserves the open-cell graph; any unreachable or malformed case is an integrity failure, not a replacement draw.
cohort.identity: Hash indices, tokens, labels, distances, original/new endpoint indices and generator counts. Require exactly4096 unique token grids and wall masks, and no token-grid or wall-mask overlap with every prior Work dataset manifest, including completed H2bo when available. An overlap/provenance failure makes the study incomplete with retained data; no replacement seed or maze.
